name: Lord Ganesha
description: The remover of obstacles, patron of arts and sciences, and the deva of intellect and wisdom.

name: Lord Shiva
description: The Destroyer, the Transformer, the Supreme Yogic Adiyogi dwelling in cosmic Kailash.

name: Lord Krishna
description: The eighth avatar of Vishnu, counselor of the Bhagavad Gita, deity of compassion, love, and divine play.

name: Goddess Durga
description: The protective mother goddess, vanquisher of Mahishasura, representing absolute feminine cosmic power (Shakti).

name: Lord Rama
description: The Maryada Purushottam, ideal king, husband, moral ideal, and the seventh avatar of Vishnu.

name: Lord Hanuman
description: The embodiment of devotion (Bhakti), wisdom, cosmic strength, and loyal commander of Lord Rama.

name: Goddess Saraswati
description: The goddess of learning, music, creative arts, speech, and cosmic wisdom, holding the divine Veena.
